title: Chardaleon
description: A region on the Red Sea coast of the Arabian peninsula, mentioned in a north-to-south list of toponyms by Pliny the Elder, and by other Greco-Roman sources. BAtlas identified it as lying in the area of the modern al-Lith governorate in Saudi Arabia.

properties.description: Label centerline extracted using QGIS from raster image of BAtlas Map 4 that was digitized and georegistered by the Ancient World Mapping Center in 2003. Dates after BAtlDir.
